description: PyBaMM is a Python battery-modelling package maintained by the PyBaMM team and contributors. It combines a differential-equation representation, battery model and parameter libraries, and tools for defining experiments and visualizing outputs. Users can change cell geometry, physical assumptions, meshes, discretisation and solvers. Simulations cover configured cells and operating sequences, with spatial and temporal resolution chosen for the selected model. The package can support battery design and storage-system or electric-vehicle studies. Source access is free under BSD-3-Clause, with installation documented for Linux, macOS and Windows. It complements fitted battery models by exposing physical model choices and parameter sets. A limitation is release compatibility: the README says main-branch examples track current development, so an installed release may require its matching examples. Parameter suitability and experimental validity also depend on the battery represented. No battery model was installed, simulated or checked against measurements.
name: PyBaMM Python Battery Mathematical Modelling
